info.title: opensesh API
info.description: The complete opensesh surface over REST: events, call for papers, submissions, evaluation, agenda, speakers, CRM, widgets, mail, and integrations. Authenticate with an organization API key (`Authorization: Bearer osk_…`) created in Organization settings → API keys. Success responses return the resource directly; every error is `{ "error": { "code", "message" } }` with a matching HTTP status.
